blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Recommended tools for this  procedure  are  a  medium  size  flat  blade  screwdriver  and mild solvent.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: The replacement parts for this procedure are:

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Extrusion, Pole Clamp Plate, Backing, Pole Clamp Insulator, Backing Plate Screw, 10-32 x 1/2, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: To  replace  the  pole  clamp  extrusion,  backing  plate,  and  insulator,  see Figure  7-9 , then proceed as follows:

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Turn off the infuser and disconnect the device from AC power.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Remove the battery as described in Section 7.2.4 .

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Separate  the  rear  enclosure  from  the  main  chassis  assembly  as  described in Section 7.2.8 .

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Using the flat blade screwdriver, remove the screws that secure the pole clamp backing plate to the pole clamp extrusion, and remove the backing plate, insulator, and pole clamp from the rear enclosure assembly.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Install the replacement backing plate and extrusion, using the screws that were removed in step 2.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Install the replacement insulator onto the backing plate.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: CAUTION: Assure  the  insulator  covers  the  entire  backing  plate.  If  the backing plate is exposed, the power supply PWA may be damaged when power is applied to the infuser.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Join  the  rear  enclosure  and  main  chassis  assembly  in  the  exact  reverse  order of separation.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Reinstall the battery and connect the device to AC power.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.1 POLE CLAMP EXTRUSION, BACKING PLATE, AND INSULATOR REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: To  verify  successful  pole  clamp  extrusion,  backing  plate,  and  insulator  replacement, perform the PVT in Section 5.2 .
